# DNA Complement Generator

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This package provides an utility for complementing a DNA sequence with robust error handling and string cleaning.

## Installation

This package can be installed with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2DingMa")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to complement a simple DNA sequence:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2DingMa)

simple_seq <- "Atggccggcaacgtgaagaagagctctggg"

complement_dna(simple_seq, upper = FALSE)
```
